title: Locked Savings Certificate Rate Sheet - Credit Builder Accounts
content:
The locked savings certificate attached to every Credit Builder Accounts plan earns the same yield on the same terms.

| Plan | Annual percentage yield (percent) | How dividends are credited | Savings withdrawable before the account closes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Credit Builder 600 Plan | 0.1 | monthly on the last day of the month | no |
| Credit Builder 1000 Plan | 0.1 | monthly on the last day of the month | no |
| Credit Builder 1200 Plan | 0.1 | monthly on the last day of the month | no |
| Credit Builder 1800 Plan | 0.1 | monthly on the last day of the month | no |
| Credit Builder 2400 Plan | 0.1 | monthly on the last day of the month | no |
| Credit Builder 3000 Plan | 0.1 | monthly on the last day of the month | no |

**Dividend method (every plan):** monthly on the last day of the month: the savings balance times the APY divided by 1200, rounded to the cent; nothing is credited when that rounds to 0.00.

The annual percentage yield is the yield paid on the locked savings certificate, in percent. Whether savings can be withdrawn before the account closes is answered "no" on every plan.

## Dividend figures (hypothetical balances)

| Savings balance on the last day of the month | Balance times 0.1 divided by 1200 | Dividend credited |
|---|---|---|
| 1000.00 | 0.0833... | 0.08 |
| 3000.00 | 0.25 | 0.25 |
| 50.00 | 0.0041... | nothing (rounds to 0.00) |
